name: Tumbao anticipation bass
desc: Salsa tumbao bass in G minor: rests on the downbeat, hits the 'and of 2', then lands the beat-4 anticipation note that rings across the barline on a long release to voice the next chord early, over an i-VI-iv-V progression that turns each cycle. Sawtooth with a slow filter bloom; peak drops a downbeat sub and gallops with octave pops.

code.sparse: note("<[~ ~ ~ g2 ~ ~ g2 ~] [~ ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 ~] [~ ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ eb2 ~] [~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ d2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(16)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.5).sustain(.35).release(.35).shape(.2).gain(${gain}*.85).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[g2 ~ g2 g2 ~ g3 d2 ~] [c2 ~ c2 c2 ~ c3 g1 ~] [eb2 ~ eb2 eb2 ~ eb3 bb1 ~] [d2 ~ d2 d2 ~ d3 a1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.4).sustain(.32).release(.35).shape(.25).gain(${gain}).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g1 g2 g2 g2 f2 g3 d2 ~] [c2 c2 c3 c2 bb1 c3 g1 ~] [eb1 eb2 eb2 eb2 d2 eb3 bb1 ~] [d1 d2 d2 d2 c2 d3 a1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).lpq(3).attack(.008).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.3).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).room(.12).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
